summary: FREK Notary (Notaire Culturel Tech) backend + frontend tested. 15/16 backend tests passed (1 skipped — non-existent /api/v1/dashboard/summary endpoint, not part of this scope). Found and fixed one routing bug: /anchor/sweep and /anchor/upgrade were declared AFTER /anchor/{height} in routes.py, causing FastAPI to match 'sweep'/'upgrade' as the {height} path param and return 422. Reordered routes — both endpoints now respond 200. Frontend Dashboard /dashboard widget-notary renders correctly with all required testids: notary-height=10, notary-anchored=11, notary-btc-confirmed=0, notary-pending=10, integrity badge='Inviolable'. OTS proof generation works (verified via /proof/{frek_id}/ots returning binary application/vnd.opentimestamps.ots after ~3-9s).

minor.issue: FIXED — route ordering bug: declared after /anchor/{height} which captured 'sweep'/'upgrade' as int height path param. Reordered routes in /app/backend/notary/routes.py.

action_items: Verify the routing fix in /app/backend/notary/routes.py (already applied) — moved /anchor/sweep and /anchor/upgrade declarations BEFORE /anchor/{height}.

Optional: Verify page /verify/{frek_id} notary panel was not visually tested because the panel only renders when legacy /api/frek/verify/{id} returns 200, and emit via /api/v1/identity/emit does not produce a legacy v2 attestation. Backend proof endpoints all work — UI gating is by design per the request brief.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering: Always declare specific path routes (sweep, upgrade) BEFORE parametrized routes ({height}) in FastAPI. Fixed.
notary/routes.py /blocks endpoint sort + skip + limit pattern is correct, but to_list(limit) parameter is the absolute count, not page size — works because it equals limit param.
service.py notarize_event swallows all exceptions silently (logger.exception only). Acceptable for non-blocking notarization but should surface in /chain/status if accumulated failures occur.
models.py BlockResponse does not expose payload_data — good (sensitive data stays internal). chain_proof returned dict could be a typed model for stronger contract.
anchor.py background_loop polls every 30s — fine. Make sure it is started exactly once on app startup (not per-request) — already wired in server.py per request brief.

BTC confirmation total_btc_confirmed=0 is expected (BTC takes 1-6h). Routing fix applied. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_notary.py is reusable as regression suite. /api/v1/notary/anchor/{height}, /anchor/sweep, /anchor/upgrade all require Bearer token with 'emit' permission.
rca_of_the_issue: Routing 422 on /api/v1/notary/anchor/sweep & /anchor/upgrade. RCA: In FastAPI, routes are matched in declaration order; the parametrized /anchor/{height} (height: int) was declared first and matched the literal strings 'sweep'/'upgrade' attempting int parsing → 422 'Input should be a valid integer'. Mitigation: declare specific literal routes before parametrized catch-all. Already fixed in /app/backend/notary/routes.py.
